title: About Jude Hill — Web Designer in Eugene
description: Jude Hill is a web designer and developer in Eugene, Oregon. Hand-coded sites for small businesses in Eugene, Springfield and Lane County, from $500 flat.

blocks.headline: Hi, I'm Jude Hill.
blocks.subheadline: I'm a high school student in Eugene, Oregon. I build fast, simple websites for small businesses and anyone with an idea.
blocks.photoAlt: Jude Hill, web designer in Eugene, Oregon, sitting on a slackline in the woods

blocks.text: I work outside of school and on the weekends. When you send me a message, it gets added to my list, and then I start working on it. I have a development version of your site that gets sent to you so we can work through changes before it goes live.
Small business sites: a few clear pages that cover what you do, what it costs, where you are, and how to reach you. New sites, or rebuilds of old slow ones.
I work with businesses in Eugene, Springfield and around Lane County, so I can come see your shop in person. You work with me directly.
